{{Quote|Get him off of there!|Newland, upon spotting an Ewok assailant|<ref name="ROJ" />}}
'''Newland,'''<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 4|cardname=Major Newland}}</ref> also known as '''Marquand'''<ref name="AMG">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stat-tempest-force-battle-force|text=Scene to Stat: Tempest Force Battle Force}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] in the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROJ" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War]], he held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[major]]<ref name="SWCT" /> and served at the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="ROJ" /> in [[4 ABY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> where he served in [[Tempest Scout 2]], an [[All Terrain Scout Transport]] with [[Lieutenant]] [[Blanaid]].<ref name="SWCT" />

==Biography==
During the Battle of Endor, the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] and two [[Ewok]]s landed on top of<ref name="ROJ" /> [[Tempest Scout 2]],<ref name="Tempest">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stat-tempest-force-battle-force|text=Scene to Stat: Tempest Force Battle Force}}</ref> Newland and Blanaid's [[All Terrain Scout Transport]], with one of the Ewoks appearing before the AT-ST's viewports and teasing the [[walker]] drivers within. Upon spotting the assailant, Newland immediately ordered Blanaid to remove the Ewok from their walker. However, when Blanaid peered out of the walker [[cockpit]]'s top hatch, the lieutenant was pulled out and thrown overboard by the Wookiee Chewbacca. This allowed the Wookiee's Ewok companions to drop into the walker cockpit and beat Newland unconscious to take control of the Imperial machine.<ref name="ROJ" />

Later in the battle, [[Han Solo]] donned Newland's uniform and helmet in a guise to trick the commander of the [[Death Star's shield generator]], Major [[Hewex]] into opening the bunker's doors, allowing the Rebels access to the control room.<ref name="ROJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Newland was played by the director of ''Return of the Jedi'', [[Richard Marquand]].<ref name="ROJ" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity, the character was named [[Newland/Legends|Marquand]], sharing a name with the director,<ref name="Endor Limited">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Major Marquand}}</ref> but his name was changed to Newland in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="SWCT" /> The name Marquand would later be used by [[Atomic Mass Games]], however.<ref name="Tempest" />
